verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Mastra lets developers build their own MCP servers and deploy their own apps, including to Mastra Cloud. It does not document a ready-made hosted remote MCP server URL that a client can use to reach downstream tools without deploying anything. Building and deploying a server yourself is a developer building block, not the zero-infrastructure hosted endpoint the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure
